Download **AutobahnRush.apk** below, open it on your Android phone and allow installing apps from this source when asked.

- More everyday traffic: city cars, hatchbacks, crossovers, people carriers, minibuses and coupés; no more supercars in traffic
- Proper wheel arches on every car, so the wheels no longer cut through the bodywork
- Crashes with other cars below 150 km/h (or at about the same speed) never total your car
- Music and sound stop when you leave the app or tab

If no release key is configured yet (see docs/ANDROID.md), the APK is debug-signed and an update may need the old version uninstalled first.
